Agua De Nopal
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:03am

Ingredients




2 Cactus Paddles
1 quart Water
1 Lemon
Sugar To Taste

Preparation

1 JUICE IT: Many Mexicans drink nopal juice because it is believed to control diabetes and relieve intestinal upsets. 2 Cut the raw paddles into pieces that will fit in your blender. Throw in 3-inch-long slices of lemon peel and sugar. Use the liquefy function until your mixture has the consistency of apple juice. Add ice and serve. 3 Serves 2.
